planningAudit.notes: Claim1 included review/discussion of the post-run manual-cancel finding as well as gameplay; exclude the entire mixed claim only in the separately reported subset, with no invented developer duration. Claims2–15 serviced actual observed gameplay. Claim4 ends at the first rejected completion submission; command-contract inspection/correction and the later stale retry were outside that closed claim, retained in whole-window totals. Claim time includes reasoning, tools, scheduling and progress/status commentary where it occurred. Observation waits were outside completed claims. No runtime/report/capture/ledger source edits occurred during the fixed window. All-claim/whole totals retain every failure, idle period and mixed interval.

planningLatency.meaning: Legacy actualClaimToCompletionMs measures claim to completion-submission receipt, before proposal validation: includes rejected claim4. Includes gameplay reasoning, tools, scheduling and intervening progress/status commentary; not isolated inference. The later unclaimed stale submission is retained in whole-run totals.

failureRate.denominator: Completed helper dispatch attempts = helper-verified completions + failed attempts; excludes passive effect steps and in-flight attempts.

failureCounting.note: Do not invent a category or successful outcome for a failed counter increment without routine_failed evidence. All failures remain in the completed-attempt rate.
